subject: W3-B Task 2 provider-independent payment evidence and reconciliation authority, failing before implementation

redResult.case: provider capture evidence exists while approved payable-total authority is missing and canonical payment authority table is absent
redResult.scope: disposable PostgreSQL with predecessor migrations 003-006, 036, 041, 049-052; owner-level SQL reveals that legacy stays_orders rejects RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED via chk_stays_orders_status, and canonical payment authority tables (canonical_payment_attempts) are absent. Provider capture evidence cannot be safely reconciled without either fabricating success or dropping evidence.

conclusion: Predecessor schema lacks provider-independent payment evidence and reconciliation authority. Without additive canonical payment tables and restricted worker procedures, inbound provider evidence cannot be idempotently normalized or reconciled against missing payable total authority.
limitations: No real money movement, remote Neon mutation, live Razorpay API, STAAH integration or public checkout was executed. This is intentionally red diagnostic evidence for Task 2 before implementation.
